maintenance_led.reason: Mostly new test equipment and optical coatings sales (network test, anti-counterfeiting pigments); repair and calibration services are a smaller part.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly telecom operators, network equipment makers, data centers and electronics manufacturers; military and aerospace are a smaller part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through its own test and optical product sales; acquisitions such as Spirent's network business are occasional, not a steady roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Test and assurance systems are embedded in network workflows, and optical filters are qualified into customers' products, so switching is costly.
